## Où j'en suis
Implemented `Idempotency-Key` support on `POST /v1/refunds` on branch `jake/refund-idempotency`: Postgres store with a unique index, 72-hour retention, in-flight retries answered with 409, docs for the header, and Tomer's two review comments addressed. `pnpm test idempotency` (21) and `pnpm test:e2e refunds` (38) are green and PR quillon/core#1437 is merged. In parallel, a read-only SQL script listed the 14 Pinecrest duplicate refunds from Nov 12; the list still needs its net amounts confirmed before it goes to Carla.

- [en-cours] Pinecrest duplicate list: 14 pairs, $3,212.40 gross duplicated, net lower because two pairs were partially reversed.
- [prochaine-étape] check the two partial reversals with Marcus, then send the list to Carla before Pinecrest's weekend payout.
- [essai-raté] Redis store abandoned (flushed on failover, would allow double refunds again) and the reversal backfill script dropped.
- [décision] use Postgres with a unique index on (merchant_id, idempotency_key) instead of Redis (source: t05)
- [décision] 72-hour key retention (source: t09)
- [décision] hash must ignore `metadata` key order and in-flight retries return 409, not 429 (source: t15)
